verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a marketing claim that users can configure the platform so each payment automatically arrives categorized by area, owner and expense type. That implies a narrow, rule-like automation on payment events. AI alerts and the approvals area are adjacent features, not user-defined event-to-action rules. missing for 10: a documented general rules engine (custom triggers, conditions and actions), webhooks or event subscriptions for programmatic automation, technical docs on how auto-categorization rules are defined, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
